trial_court: Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, (Negotiable Instrument Act) -07, South, SAKET Courts, New Delhi, CT Cases 470644/2016

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sh. Ashish Aggarwal, s/o Late Sh. Omprakash Aggarwal
parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. Rakesh Bhatia, s/o Darshan Lal Bhatia

facts_of_case: Complainant Sh. Ashish Aggarwal filed a complaint under Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act against accused Sh. Rakesh Bhatia alleging dishonoured cheques. Accused pleaded not guilty and claimed trial.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove that the accused had signed the agreement and received the loan amount.
legal_principles.held: He further stated that he was assured by complainant and Prashant Kansal that amount of Rs.25 lakhs shall be credited in his bank account soon, however, no such amount was ever credited in his bank account.

legal_principles.principle: A person's statement that he does not remember certain details is not sufficient to disprove the existence of those facts.
legal_principles.held: He further stated that he does not remember dates of cheques or the bank upon which said cheques were given by accused to complainant.

use_for_drafting: drafting a complaint under Section 138 NI Act
preparing for trial in cheque bounce cases
understanding the acquittal of an accused
